svg.aria-label: Capability against blended token price at author list prices, 2026-11-09

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Open weights are much cheaper, until they run out of capability
Blended price per million tokens at 5 input tokens per output token, at the cheapest provider serving fp8 or better. Lines trace
the cheapest model of each kind clearing a capability floor. OpenRouter endpoints and Artificial Analysis index, 2026-11-09.
USD per million tokens, blended 5:1, log scale
cheapest open above the mid floor
Cheapest model clearing each capability floor, at author list prices, blended 5:1
How much the answer depends on which price you can actually get
Cheapest at fp8 or better (base case)
The discount depends heavily on the basis. The crossover does not move: it is set by open models running out of capability at 31.7,
not by price. It also holds across every token mix tested, from output-only to 20:1.
51 scored base SKUs at the base case. Standard-tier endpoints only. Undeclared precision counts as fp8 or better, since closed providers rarely disclose it.
Capability index may lag recent releases and covers 54 of 430 priced models. This compares off-the-shelf models at API prices, not post-trained or self-hosted ones.
Sources: OpenRouter endpoints API, provider pricing pages, Artificial Analysis
